newsitem.title: YUGOSLAVIA: Yugo sows 1.37 mln ha under maize, 5pct down on 96.
newsitem.headline: Yugo sows 1.37 mln ha under maize, 5pct down on 96.

text.p: Yugoslavia has sown 1.37 million hectares with maize this year, down five percent or 72,000 ha on 1996, the Federal Statistics Office said in its latest report on Friday.
The office based its report on the state of the crops on May 31.

Total sugarbeet area of 56,000 ha this year is lower by 13,500 ha or 19 percent on the area sown in 1996. Agricultural enterprises and farm cooperatives sowed 34,000 ha and individual farms 22,000 ha.
Sunflower was sown on some 160,000 hectares, around 46,000 ha or 22 percent less than the previous year.
Soybean was sown on some 61,000 hectares or 16 percent down on last year.
The government plan was to sow 1.4 million ha with maize, 100,000 ha with sugarbeet, 200,000 with sunflower and 80,000 ha with soybean this year.
The office said it would have final data on area sown at the end of July. -- Beti Bilandzic, Belgrade newsroom +381 11 222 43 05
